name: OGEEAT
author: wpformation

sections.description:
Your content deserves to be found — not just by Google, but by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and every AI engine reshaping how people discover information. OGEEAT is the first WordPress plugin that bridges traditional SEO and the AI era by managing your digital identity, authority signals, and AI citability in one place.

Most SEO plugins optimize for Google rankings. OGEEAT goes further: it tells search engines who you are, proves why you’re an expert, and makes your site citable by AI.

4 pillars, one plugin:

  • Open Graph & Twitter Cards — Beautiful social previews generated automatically for every page and post, with a live preview in the editor
  • E-E-A-T Schemas — Person, Organization, and Article JSON-LD schemas with entity linking. Google’s quality signals, structured for machines
  • GEO Score — A 6-check citability score that tells you exactly how ready each post is for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
  • llms.txt & llms-full.txt — Your AI business card. A structured site index enriched with E-E-A-T data that AI engines actually understand

llms.txt — Why it matters:

AI engines need structured data to cite your content. OGEEAT generates two files:

  • /llms.txt — Your organization details, author credentials, expertise, certifications, and content links in a format designed for LLMs
  • /llms-full.txt — The full version with article content, categories, tags, and publication dates

Unlike basic llms.txt generators that only list URLs, OGEEAT enriches both files with your E-E-A-T data: who you are, what you know, why you should be cited. You control the max number of posts, words per article, post types included, and can exclude individual posts.

Not a SEO plugin — a post-SEO plugin:

No sitemaps, no keyword stuffing tools, no redirections. OGEEAT complements your existing SEO plugin by adding what it doesn’t: identity, authority, and AI readiness.

Works with your stack:

  • Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO — or no SEO plugin at all
  • Auto-detects existing OG handlers and defers gracefully
  • Detects llms.txt conflicts and lets you choose

Version francaise :

Votre contenu merite d’etre trouve — pas seulement par Google, mais aussi par ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini et tous les moteurs IA qui transforment la facon dont les gens trouvent l’information. OGEEAT est le premier plugin WordPress qui fait le pont entre le SEO traditionnel et l’ere de l’IA en gerant votre identite numerique, vos signaux d’autorite et votre citabilite IA au meme endroit.

La plupart des plugins SEO optimisent pour le classement Google. OGEEAT va plus loin : il dit aux moteurs de recherche qui vous etes, prouve pourquoi vous etes expert, et rend votre site citable par l’IA.

4 piliers, un seul plugin :

  • Open Graph & Twitter Cards — Apercu social genere automatiquement pour chaque page et article, avec previsualisation en direct dans l’editeur
  • Schemas E-E-A-T — Schemas JSON-LD Person, Organization et Article avec liaison d’entites. Les signaux de qualite Google, structures pour les machines
  • Score GEO — Un score de citabilite en 6 criteres qui vous dit exactement si chaque article est pret pour les moteurs IA (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
  • llms.txt & llms-full.txt — Votre carte de visite IA. Un index structure du site enrichi avec vos donnees E-E-A-T que les moteurs IA comprennent vraiment

llms.txt — Pourquoi c’est important :

Les moteurs IA ont besoin de donnees structurees pour citer votre contenu. OGEEAT genere deux fichiers :

  • /llms.txt — Votre organisation, les credentials de vos auteurs, leur expertise, leurs certifications et vos liens de contenu dans un format concu pour les LLM
  • /llms-full.txt — La version complete avec le contenu des articles, categories, tags et dates de publication

Contrairement aux generateurs llms.txt basiques qui ne listent que des URLs, OGEEAT enrichit les deux fichiers avec vos donnees E-E-A-T : qui vous etes, ce que vous savez, pourquoi vous devriez etre cite. Vous controlez le nombre d’articles, de mots par article, les types de contenus, et pouvez exclure individuellement chaque article.

Pas un plugin SEO — un plugin post-SEO :

Pas de sitemaps, pas d’optimisation de mots-cles, pas de redirections. OGEEAT complete votre plugin SEO existant en ajoutant ce qu’il ne fait pas : l’identite, l’autorite et la preparation a l’IA.

Compatible avec votre stack :

  • Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO — ou aucun plugin SEO
  • Detection automatique des gestionnaires OG existants
  • Detection des conflits llms.txt avec choix utilisateur

External services

Gravatar (Automattic)

This plugin uses WordPress core’s get_avatar_url() to display author avatars. WordPress may send a hashed email to Gravatar servers. This is controlled by Settings > Discussion > Avatars. See Automattic Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ogeeat folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → OGEEAT to configure
  4. Fill in your author profile under Users → Profile
sections.faq:
Does OGEEAT replace Yoast or Rank Math?

No. OGEEAT complements your SEO plugin by adding E-E-A-T schemas and GEO optimization that SEO plugins don’t provide.

OGEEAT remplace-t-il Yoast ou Rank Math ?

Non. OGEEAT complete votre plugin SEO en ajoutant les schemas E-E-A-T et l’optimisation GEO que les plugins SEO ne proposent pas.

What happens if I use Yoast and OGEEAT?

OGEEAT detects Yoast’s Open Graph settings. If Yoast handles OG tags, OGEEAT disables its own OG module automatically. E-E-A-T and GEO features remain active.

What is E-E-A-T?

Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness — Google’s quality signals. OGEEAT generates structured data (Schema.org) that communicates your expertise to search engines and AI.

Qu’est-ce que l’E-E-A-T ?

Experience, Expertise, Autorite, Fiabilite — les signaux de qualite de Google. OGEEAT genere des donnees structurees (Schema.org) qui communiquent votre expertise aux moteurs de recherche et a l’IA.

What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimization — optimizing content to be cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. OGEEAT scores each post on 6 citability checks.

Qu’est-ce que le GEO ?

Generative Engine Optimization — l’optimisation du contenu pour etre cite par les moteurs IA comme ChatGPT, Perplexity et Google AI Overviews. OGEEAT evalue chaque article sur 6 criteres de citabilite.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is a structured text file that helps AI engines understand your site, your expertise, and your content. Think of it as robots.txt for AI — but instead of blocking, it invites and informs.

Qu’est-ce que llms.txt ?

llms.txt est un fichier texte structure qui aide les moteurs IA a comprendre votre site, votre expertise et votre contenu. C’est comme un robots.txt pour l’IA — mais au lieu de bloquer, il invite et informe.

Is OGEEAT free? / OGEEAT est-il gratuit ?

Yes, completely free with no premium upsells. / Oui, entierement gratuit, sans version premium cachee.

1.2.3

  • Version bump for WordPress.org submission

1.2.2

  • Fixed: All Plugin Check (PCP) errors resolved — zero errors
  • Fixed: Missing translators comments for i18n compliance
  • Fixed: Escape output for all dynamic values (nonces, counts)
  • Fixed: Input sanitization on all form saves
  • Fixed: Tested up to WordPress 6.9
  • Removed: Deprecated load_plugin_textdomain() call (auto-loaded since WP 4.6)
  • Improved: Social sharing fields hidden when SEO plugin manages OG tags
  • Improved: Clearer field labels — “Sharing Title/Description/Image” instead of “SEO / Social”
  • Improved: Contextual explanation when SEO plugin handles social fields

1.2.1

  • Improved: Settings page redesigned with White Cards pattern (modern admin UI)
  • Improved: Max-width constraint (860px) on settings page for readability
  • Improved: Dashboard widget — lighter borders, thinner progress bars, badge pills
  • Improved: Entity map icons enlarged (42px) with thicker link lines
  • Improved: GEO hero ring reduced (64px) for better proportion
  • Improved: LLMS links simplified from pills to clean text links
  • Improved: Author box CSS redesigned (premium light style)

1.2.0

  • NEW: Yoast SEO / Website LLMs.txt conflict detection — auto-disables OGEEAT LLMS when another plugin handles llms.txt
  • NEW: Per-post LLMS.txt exclusion toggle in the editor metabox
  • NEW: LLMS.txt stats in dashboard widget (URL count, active status, links)
  • NEW: Auto-flush rewrite rules on plugin update (fixes llms-full.txt 404)
  • Redesigned: Grey background metabox (Yoast-style) — no more white-on-white
  • Redesigned: White content cards on grey background for clear visual hierarchy
  • Improved: Settings AI tab shows conflict warning and post count
  • Improved: Cleaner, more compact dashboard widget

1.1.1

  • Redesigned: Professional CSS with constrained content width (760px max)
  • Redesigned: Better spacing, typography, shadows, and transitions throughout
  • NEW: LLMS.txt status card in post editor metabox
  • Improved: Dashboard widget cards with hover effects
  • Improved: Input fields with focus states and border-radius

1.1.0

  • NEW: LLMS.txt and llms-full.txt generation with E-E-A-T enrichment
  • NEW: Author credentials, organization details, and entity relationships in llms.txt
  • NEW: Descriptive help text and WPFormation links in all settings tabs
  • Improved: Dashboard widget with 3 metric cards (GEO, OG, E-E-A-T)
  • Improved: Persistent dismiss for SEO plugin notice
  • Fixed: Metabox centering to match WordPress admin layout

1.0.1

  • Redesigned GEO score with hero gradient, badges, and contextual messages
  • Added schema status panel and entity linking map
  • Improved E-E-A-T author card with completion ring
  • 8 additional E-E-A-T checks for author profile audit

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Open Graph & Twitter Card meta tags
  • E-E-A-T schemas: Person, Organization, Article
  • GEO citability score (6 checks)
  • Social preview in post editor
  • SEO plugin conflict detection
  • French translation included
